pitchEn: Gravity Leap is a physics slingshot game: hop from planet to planet by riding each world's gravity. Time your thrust to swing off along the tangent and reach the next planet across 16 hand-tuned levels with orbiting moons, asteroid belts, black holes and a gravity slingshot. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
newFeaturesEn: First release of Gravity Leap: a canvas-2D gravity slingshot game with 16 procedural levels, orbiting moons, asteroid belts and black holes, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game, hold the left/right buttons to rotate your craft and press GAS to thrust; use each planet's gravity to slingshot toward the next planet and clear the level. No account, login, or internet connection is required.
